match_coverage_explanation: The 2026 Nostradamus page renders the complete tournament bracket: all 12 group-stage tabs (A-L, 72 group matches) plus every knockout round (sestnajstina finala/R32 -> osmina finala/R16 -> cetrtfinale/QF -> polfinale/SF -> finale). The navodila place no broadcast restriction on predictions (general wording 'Za posamezno tekmo lahko izid napoveste'), and the press release states goals/results from all 104 matches are available in the app. TV Slovenija broadcasts only 64 of 104 matches (32 group + all 32 knockout), but that is a TV-rights detail separate from the prediction app, which is a standalone MMC web product. Prior editions (Qatar 2022, EURO 2024) likewise covered every tournament match. As of 2026-06-05 the knockout sections show 'Trenutno se ni mogoce oddati napovedi za izide tekem' because participants are not yet known; those matches open as the bracket fills.
deadlines: per-match kickoff; predictions can be entered and edited any time until each match begins ('Za posamezno tekmo lahko izid napoveste (in tudi spremenite napoved) kadar koli do samega zacetka tekme.')
jokers_bonuses: None. The only multiplier is the knockout-stage doubling (R32 through the final). No jokers, bonus picks, or other multipliers are mentioned in the 2026 navodila.
notes: Confirmed verbatim from the 2026 navodila page. Scoring example (match 2:1): exact score (2:1) = 3 pts; correct outcome + one team's exact goal count (e.g. 2:0, 3:1) = 2 pts; correct outcome only (e.g. 1:0, 3:2) = 1 pt; wrong outcome (0:0, 0:1, 2:4) = 0. Resolution: 'Uposteva se izid dosezen po 90 minutah (redni del brez podaljska in enajstmetrovk).' Doubling: 'V zakljucnih fazah tekmovanja (od sestnajstine finala pa vse do velikega finala) se vrednosti vase napovedi podvojijo.' NOTE on terminology: 'sestnajstina finala' literally = one-sixteenth-final = the Round of 32 (16 matches), which is the FIRST knockout round in a 48-team World Cup; 'osmina finala' = Round of 16. So doubling correctly starts at R32, matching the project's working assumption. (A machine translation initially mislabeled 'sestnajstina finala' as 'Round of 16' - that is wrong.) Group-stage values are single. Tournament structure: 48 teams, 12 groups of 4, 72 group matches + 32 knockout = 104 total. Press release dated ~2026-04-07.
